I don't use chemical fertilizer on this rented plot because the crop I grow here doesn't need it the way teff or wheat do. I spread manure from my cattle and sheep to keep the soil fertile, and I sow seed I saved from my own harvest last season. My family puts in most of the work across the season, but I hire a few day laborers when the weeding and harvesting get heavy.
